premise: Woodpecker drums and drums, and Acorn and Pinecone wonder who he's talking to; nobody answers, but Acorn says "once more!" — and when he taps one more time, far away, another drum answers.
inspiration: The echo motif of folk tales (the voice that calls back from far away) and the folk-tale third try, turned: the answer isn't an echo but a real friend, and it comes because Woodpecker keeps calling.
lesson: Keep calling out; a friend may be listening.

en-US.title: Woodpecker Drums Hello
en-US.text: [excited] {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Woodpecker clung to the bark of the big tree {woodpecker:live drum} {sfx:drum} and drummed. Rat-a-tat-TAT! Along walked little {acorn:enter} Acorn, and {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to acorn} Pinecone came rolling after her. {acorn:face surprised} [curious] "Who are you talking to?" asked Acorn. {woodpecker:face sad} "A friend I haven't met yet," said Woodpecker. "Somewhere far away." He {woodpecker:live tap hold} tapped again, and listened. [whispers] Nothing. {pinecone:face sad} Nothing at all. {acorn:face sad} Acorn wanted to help. "Once more!" she said, and she {acorn:live wish hold} closed her eyes tight and wished. Pinecone {pinecone:live open} opened all her scales, as if every one of them could listen. {woodpecker:live tap resume} So Woodpecker tapped one more time. {sfx:far-drum solo} Far, far away, someone drummed back! {acorn:live wish resume} Acorn's eyes popped open. {pinecone:face surprised} [gasps] "Did you hear that?" {woodpecker:face happy} "Rat-a-tat, hello!" drummed Woodpecker. "Rat-a-tat, hello, hello!" drummed the friend far away. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x2} {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live bounce} Acorn and Pinecone bounced for joy. [happily] A brand-new friend… and they hadn't even met yet.

es-ES.title: El tambor de Carpintero
es-ES.text: [excited] {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Pájaro carpintero se agarró a la corteza del árbol grande {woodpecker:live drum} {sfx:drum} y tamborileó. ¡Ra-ta-ta-TÁ! Por allí llegó la pequeña {acorn:enter} Bellota, y detrás, rodando, {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to acorn} Piña. {acorn:face surprised} [curious] —¿Con quién hablas? —preguntó Bellota. {woodpecker:face sad} —Con un amigo al que aún no conozco —dijo Carpintero—. Uno que vive lejos. {woodpecker:live tap hold} Tocó otra vez, y se quedó escuchando. [whispers] Nada. {pinecone:face sad} Nada de nada. {acorn:face sad} Bellota quería ayudar. —¡Otra vez! —dijo, y {acorn:live wish hold} cerró los ojos muy fuerte y pidió un deseo. Piña {pinecone:live open} abrió todas sus escamas, como si cada una pudiera escuchar. {woodpecker:live tap resume} Así que Carpintero tocó una vez más. {sfx:far-drum solo} ¡A lo lejos, muy lejos, alguien contestó! {acorn:live wish resume} Bellota abrió los ojos de par en par. {pinecone:face surprised} [gasps] —¿Lo habéis oído? {woodpecker:face happy} —Ra-ta-tá, ¡hola! —tamborileó Carpintero. —Ra-ta-tá, ¡hola, hola! —contestó el amigo lejano. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x2} {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live bounce} Bellota y Piña dieron saltos de alegría. [happily] Un amigo nuevo… y todavía ni se conocían.

ja-JP.title: キツツキくんの こんにちは
ja-JP.text: [excited]{woodpecker:enter}{woodpecker:go to trunks}キツツキくんが、大きな木のみきにつかまって、{woodpecker:live drum}{sfx:drum}たいこをたたきます。タタタタ、タン！そこへ小さな{acorn:enter}どんぐりがてくてく。{pinecone:enter}{pinecone:go to acorn}まつぼっくりも、ころころ。{acorn:face surprised}[curious]「だれとおはなししてるの？」 とどんぐり。{woodpecker:face sad}「まだあったことのない、おともだち。どこか、とおくにいるんだ」 キツツキくんは{woodpecker:live tap hold}またたたいて、耳をすませました。[whispers]しーん。{pinecone:face sad}なんにも、きこえません。{acorn:face sad}どんぐりは、てつだいたくて「もういっかい！」 そして{acorn:live wish hold}目をぎゅっとつぶって、おねがい。まつぼっくりは{pinecone:live open}かさをぜんぶひらきました。ひとつひとつが、耳みたいに。{woodpecker:live tap resume}キツツキくんは、もういっかい。{sfx:far-drum solo}とおく、とおくで、だれかがこたえた！{acorn:live wish resume}どんぐりの目が、ぱちっ。{pinecone:face surprised}[gasps]「きこえた？」 {woodpecker:face happy}「タタタ、こんにちは！」 とキツツキくん。「タタタ、こんにちは、こんにちは！」 と、とおくのおともだち。{acorn:face happy}{acorn:hop x2}{pinecone:face happy}{pinecone:live bounce}ふたりは、ぴょんぴょんおおよろこび。[happily]あたらしいおともだち…まだ、あってもいないのにね。

de-DE.title: Der Specht trommelt Hallo
de-DE.text: [excited] {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Der Specht klammerte sich an die Rinde des großen Baumes {woodpecker:live drum} {sfx:drum} und trommelte. Tock-tock-tock-TOCK! Da kam die kleine {acorn:enter} Eichel daher, und {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to acorn} der Tannenzapfen rollte hinterher. {acorn:face surprised} [curious] „Mit wem redest du denn?“, fragte die Eichel. {woodpecker:face sad} „Mit einem Freund, den ich noch nicht kenne“, sagte der Specht. „Irgendwo weit weg.“ Er {woodpecker:live tap hold} klopfte noch einmal und lauschte. [whispers] Nichts. {pinecone:face sad} Gar nichts. {acorn:face sad} Die Eichel wollte helfen. „Noch einmal!“, sagte sie, und {acorn:live wish hold} sie kniff die Augen fest zu und wünschte sich etwas. Der Tannenzapfen {pinecone:live open} öffnete alle seine Schuppen, als könnte jede einzelne mithorchen. {woodpecker:live tap resume} Also klopfte der Specht noch ein letztes Mal. {sfx:far-drum solo} Weit, weit weg trommelte jemand zurück! {acorn:live wish resume} Die Eichel riss die Augen auf. {pinecone:face surprised} [gasps] „Habt ihr das gehört?“ {woodpecker:face happy} „Tock-tock, hallo!“, trommelte der Specht. „Tock-tock, hallo, hallo!“, trommelte der Freund weit weg. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x2} {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live bounce} Die Eichel und der Tannenzapfen hüpften vor Freude. [happily] Ein ganz neuer Freund… und dabei kannten sie sich noch gar nicht.

fr-FR.title: Le bonjour de Pic-vert
fr-FR.text: [excited] {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Pic-vert s’est accroché à l’écorce du grand arbre {woodpecker:live drum} {sfx:drum} et il a tambouriné. Ra-ta-ta-TA ! Le petit {acorn:enter} Gland passait par là, et {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to acorn} Pomme de pin roulait derrière lui. {acorn:face surprised} [curious] « À qui tu parles ? » a demandé Gland. {woodpecker:face sad} « À un ami que je ne connais pas encore, a dit Pic-vert. Quelque part, très loin. » Il {woodpecker:live tap hold} a encore tapé, et il a écouté. [whispers] Rien. {pinecone:face sad} Rien de rien. {acorn:face sad} Gland voulait l’aider. « Encore une fois ! » a-t-il dit, et il {acorn:live wish hold} a fermé les yeux très fort pour faire un vœu. Pomme de pin {pinecone:live open} a ouvert toutes ses écailles, comme si chacune pouvait écouter. {woodpecker:live tap resume} Alors Pic-vert a tapé une dernière fois. {sfx:far-drum solo} Très loin, très loin, quelqu’un a répondu en tambourinant ! {acorn:live wish resume} Gland a ouvert grand les yeux. {pinecone:face surprised} [gasps] « Vous avez entendu ? » {woodpecker:face happy} « Ra-ta-ta, bonjour ! » a tambouriné Pic-vert. « Ra-ta-ta, bonjour, bonjour ! » a tambouriné l’ami lointain. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x2} {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live bounce} Gland et Pomme de pin ont sauté de joie. [happily] Un tout nouvel ami… et ils ne s’étaient même pas encore rencontrés.

it-IT.title: Picchio saluta col tamburo
it-IT.text: [excited] {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Picchio si è aggrappato alla corteccia del grande albero {woodpecker:live drum} {sfx:drum} e ha tamburellato. TOC-TOC-TOC! Ecco arrivare la piccola {acorn:enter} Ghianda, e dietro di lei, rotolando, {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to acorn} Pigna. {acorn:face surprised} [curious] «Con chi parli?» ha chiesto Ghianda. {woodpecker:face sad} «Con un amico che non conosco ancora», ha detto Picchio. «Uno che sta lontano lontano.» Poi {woodpecker:live tap hold} ha bussato di nuovo, ed è rimasto in ascolto. [whispers] Niente. {pinecone:face sad} Proprio niente. {acorn:face sad} Ghianda voleva aiutarlo. «Ancora una volta!» ha detto, e {acorn:live wish hold} ha chiuso forte gli occhi e ha espresso un desiderio. Pigna {pinecone:live open} ha aperto tutte le sue squame, come se ognuna potesse ascoltare. {woodpecker:live tap resume} Così Picchio ha bussato un'altra volta. {sfx:far-drum solo} Lontano lontano, qualcuno ha risposto! {acorn:live wish resume} Ghianda ha spalancato gli occhi. {pinecone:face surprised} [gasps] «Avete sentito?» {woodpecker:face happy} «Toc-toc, ciao!» ha tamburellato Picchio. «Toc-toc, ciao, ciao!» ha risposto l'amico lontano. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x2} {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live bounce} Ghianda e Pigna saltavano di gioia. [happily] Un amico nuovo di zecca… e non si erano nemmeno ancora visti.

zh-TW.title: 啄木鳥敲鼓說你好
zh-TW.text: [excited]{woodpecker:enter}{woodpecker:go to trunks}啄木鳥緊緊抓著大樹的樹皮，{woodpecker:live drum}{sfx:drum}打起鼓來。叩叩叩叩——叩！{acorn:enter}小小的橡實走了過來，{pinecone:enter}{pinecone:go to acorn}松果也跟在她後面滾過來。{acorn:face surprised}[curious]「你在跟誰說話呀？」 橡實問。{woodpecker:face sad}「一個我還沒見過的朋友，」 啄木鳥說，「住在好遠好遠的地方。」 牠{woodpecker:live tap hold}又敲了敲，然後仔細聽。[whispers]什麼也沒有。{pinecone:face sad}一點聲音也沒有。{acorn:face sad}橡實好想幫忙。「再一次！」 她說，然後{acorn:live wish hold}緊緊閉上眼睛，許了一個願。松果{pinecone:live open}張開她所有的鱗片，好像每一片都能聽一樣。{woodpecker:live tap resume}於是，啄木鳥又敲了一次……{sfx:far-drum solo}好遠好遠的地方，有人敲回來了！{acorn:live wish resume}橡實一下子睜開眼睛。{pinecone:face surprised}[gasps]「你們聽到了嗎？」 {woodpecker:face happy}「叩叩叩，你好！」 啄木鳥敲著。「叩叩叩，你好，你好！」 遠方的朋友也敲著。{acorn:face happy}{acorn:hop x2}{pinecone:face happy}{pinecone:live bounce}橡實和松果開心得跳了起來。[happily]多了一個新朋友……而且，牠們還沒見過面呢。

zh-HK.title: 啄木鳥打鼓說哈囉
zh-HK.text: [excited]{woodpecker:enter}{woodpecker:go to trunks}啄木鳥緊緊抓住大樹的樹皮，{woodpecker:live drum}{sfx:drum}打起鼓來。篤篤篤篤——篤！小小的{acorn:enter}橡實走了過來，{pinecone:enter}{pinecone:go to acorn}松果也跟在她後面滾過來。{acorn:face surprised}[curious]「你同邊個傾偈呀？」 橡實問。{woodpecker:face sad}「一個我未見過面嘅朋友，」 啄木鳥說，「佢喺好遠好遠嘅地方。」 牠{woodpecker:live tap hold}又敲了敲，然後側着頭聽。[whispers]沒有回音。{pinecone:face sad}一點聲音也沒有。{acorn:face sad}橡實很想幫忙。「再試多次！」 她說，然後{acorn:live wish hold}緊緊閉上眼睛，許了一個願。松果{pinecone:live open}張開所有鱗片，好像每一片都會聽一樣。{woodpecker:live tap resume}於是，啄木鳥再敲了一次。{sfx:far-drum solo}很遠很遠的地方，有人敲回來了！{acorn:live wish resume}橡實的眼睛一下子張開。{pinecone:face surprised}[gasps]「你哋聽唔聽到呀？」 {woodpecker:face happy}「篤篤篤，哈囉！」 啄木鳥敲着。「篤篤篤，哈囉，哈囉！」 遠方的朋友也敲着。{acorn:face happy}{acorn:hop x2}{pinecone:face happy}{pinecone:live bounce}橡實和松果開心得跳起來。[happily]多了一個新朋友……而且大家還未見過面呢。
